name: a1mini-petg-008-lego-v8
description: A1 mini 0.4, 0.08 mm, slow PETG walls, LEGO clutch fit, gyroid infill, elephant-foot compensation, enforcer-only supports with unified 0.24 mm Z-gap (thick_bridges=0, 3 spaced interface layers @ 0.35 mm), plus ceiling recipe 8: plate sockets 2.2 mm deep, 0.24 mm anchored ceiling bridge bands, span-cutting ribs. Per-object outer brim on small-contact (<20 mm2) or tall slender (H/eqD >= 2.5, H >= 15 mm) parts. Recommended PETG profile.

lego_safety.thick_bridges: 0 (ceilings recipe8 supplies 0.24 mm bridge height-range bands for socket ceilings while thick_bridges=0 keeps normal(manual) and tree(auto) support Z-gaps unified at 0.24 mm physical air without 0.72 mm cliffs under curved overhangs)

provenance: Seagull MMMB027-1 v8 (seagull/build_ceiling_v6.py + build_bridges_v8.py), CLI-verified 2026-11-11; updated 2026-11-25 after Enzo 8652-1 G-code audit: gyroid infill, elefant_foot_compensation 0.10, thick_bridges=0 with support_top_z_distance 0.24 + 3 interface layers @ 0.35 mm spacing (CLI G-code verified +0.243 mm physical air gap on both normal(manual) and tree(auto) supports while recipe8 0.24 mm bands keep thick 0.21-0.34 mm socket bridges), plus slender-part brim eligibility (H/eqD >= 2.5, H >= 15 mm); --fit 0.03 clutch compatibility preserved
